semantic_danger.source: red status pills observed; exact bg not sampled

typography.monospace_usage: IDs, keys, request IDs, token numbers

components_observed: fixed grouped sidebar with icons and collapsed state
top bar with product breadcrumb, Docs/Blog, theme toggle, avatar
page header: title + one-line subtitle + primary CTA
filter bar: search input, scope select, columns/filters buttons
data table: sortable headers, status pills, row actions, pagination
card grid (MCP servers) with health pills
bar chart with sparse axis labels
modal with blurred backdrop and one-time secret reveal
date range and global scope selectors
patterns: one primary CTA per page, top-right or under the title
one-time secret shown in a blocking modal with copy button
scope selector (Global / team / user) at the top of data pages
tabs group related views instead of separate nav entries
dense logs table with inline status and cost
empty list still shows footer pagination
warning banners for environment credentials and pricing gaps
observed_weaknesses: badge proliferation (Beta tags in nav and headers)
flat 13px type hierarchy across page chrome
deep saturated logo blue clashes with near-black CTA language
desktop-only shell; no mobile adaptation evidence
dense tables without strong visual grouping
no obvious empty-state illustration or guided onboarding
